name: EH3D-DESIGN-EXPLORER
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: early code. A Rust library and command line that read a set of alternatives of a design (parameters and figures that each name their tool and version) with its criteria, check it, show the place of every alternative (non-dominated, or dominated and by whom) without naming a single best one, list what differs between two alternatives and generate the grid of a parametric sweep in a fixed order. It has only run on data made by its own tests; it computes no figure, applies no change to a design and starts no job, and the comparison of branches of the design history is not written.
